name: Bomb Maze
author: Retro Console
description: Lay bombs, blast the crates and chain the explosions to trap wandering blobs, chasers and ghosts. Dig up power-ups, find the hidden exit and survive ten ever-trickier mazes.

achievements.name: First Blast
achievements.desc: Defeat a critter with a bomb

achievements.name: Chain Reaction
achievements.desc: Set off three bombs in a single chain

achievements.name: Fully Loaded
achievements.desc: Find all five kinds of power-up in one run
